decision: External browser ingress for the already deployed owner-only demo under its inherited Cloud Run policy
decision_limits: Winner not established. No head-to-head owner-browser results on P1; OAuth and approval remain unknown. Staging success is not an end-user acceptance pass.

evidence.claim: One healthy revision, IAP enabled, run.invoker granted only to the IAP service agent, one service-level IAP human principal equal to owner. Signed exact image deployed. No invitation grants.
evidence.source: Live service and IAM inventory in private service.json, run-policy.json and iap-policy.json

evidence.claim: Direct Cloud Run IAP protects all ingress, including load balancers and run.app. External Google identities require external/custom OAuth configuration. IAP must not be enabled on both layers.

An additional external HTTPS load balancer requires a forwarding rule priced at USD 0.025/hour, USD 18.25 at 730 hours, before other charges; the direct run.app option adds no forwarding rule. This compares only incremental forwarding-rule cost, not total cost.
evidence.source: https://cloud.google.com/load-balancing/pricing plus architectural forwarding-rule count and 730-hour arithmetic

evidence.claim: The deployed service uses the only currently allowed ingress value, internal-and-cloud-load-balancing. This admits an external load-balancer path; that path is not yet configured or tested.
evidence.source: Live effective policy and deployment success in private policy-run.allowedIngress.json and service.json

evidence.claim: Current docs list supported service-resource-tag legacy constraints; run.allowedIngress is absent. A service-tag-only exception is not established. A proposed project policy would allow all and the existing internal-and-cloud-load-balancing value only at the project, not change IAM authentication or parent policies.

Two fresh Cloud Run job executions using the signed image, dedicated identity and restricted network verified locked policy, preference persistence and allowed/denied HTTPS egress. Owner browser login, non-owner denial, and live Gradio streaming remain untested.
evidence.source: Private runtime-probe-logs.json; source week2/cloud_app.py and week2/iap.py

evidence.claim: Among four tested org-policy permissions, current operator has get and lacks create, update, delete. A policy administrator is required for a project exception. Project IAP settings have no custom OAuth client; external-account OAuth setup is outstanding.
evidence.source: Private project-policy-permissions.json and iap-settings.json; Cloud Resource Manager testIamPermissions and IAP settings get, 2026-11-17
